preconditions.description: The number of brains n must be between 2 and 200000.

preconditions.expression: len(p) == n - 1 and all(1 <= p[i] <= i for i in range(n - 1))
preconditions.description: The list p must contain n-1 integers, each representing a valid parent brain index.

postconditions.description: The output must contain exactly n-1 space-separated numbers representing the brain latencies.
Each brain latency must be a positive integer.
